summary: Re-review of the post-split story. The split the prior receipt recommended has landed cleanly: three leaves, each independently accepted (behavior_count 1, at most three responsibilities). Decomposition is sound. d1 = simulation behavior: CreatureDefs plus the sim-side section 52 scale rules (speed mismatch F, fauna-first environment reaction D, sonar-scale signal E, non-targetable) with one headless signature scenario per organism asserting the AC-roster-large floors from sim visibility state; subsystems [world content data, creature simulation, headless scenario tests]. d2 (depends on d1) = section 52 rendering: spine extension, foreground occluder, parallax pass, no center framing, all reading sim state, plus the tier's browser spot-checks; subsystem [procedural creature rendering]. d3 (depends on d1 and d2) = production placement plus the two roster-wide FINAL PROOFS (AC-roster-count world-data check; AC-roster-tests test-existence check plus spoiler audit of all ST-03 commits); subsystems [world content data, headless scenario tests]. Each child carries a strict subset of the parent's criteria and a strict subset of its subsystems. Dependency order d1 -> d2 -> d3 is acyclic with no ancestor or descendant dependency; d1 inherits WI-03a/b/c through the story so the fauna-announcement scenarios observe the other tiers' species. Acceptance is preserved: the children's criteria are verbatim and their union covers all three parent criteria (AC-roster-count in d3; AC-roster-large in d1 and d2; AC-roster-tests in d1, d2 and d3). Final proof ownership is named: d3 owns the FINAL PROOF for AC-roster-count and AC-roster-tests as cross-child roster-wide checks, explicitly routing any defect to the existing fix-planning route rather than fixing it in place; AC-roster-large is split by layer with named owners - d1 the headless/behavior half (fauna-announcement ordering preceding any direct sight or sound; no-clean-view from the sim's visibility state) and d2 the presentation half (the encounter never presents a clean full-body view on screen) - and the player-facing no-clean-view floor genuinely requires both the sim and the render layers to agree, a cross-layer proof, not a hidden-scope gap. Scope is preserved from the pre-split leaf with no requirement dropped and no subsystem relabeled. No findings requiring split or revise.
